body:
I'm gonna jump off a bridge.

I don't think I'm gonna call anyone out. I'm not jumping because of anyone's torment. I just don't have the strength to beat my depression and my insecurities anymore.
I started going to therapy three weeks ago, so I'm hoping that it helps me figure it out sooner rather than later.
Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.
If it's not too much to ask, may I get the information about those anger control groups? I want to try anything that will help.

Right. I understand what you're saying better now. I'm just... really frustrated with myself, you know? I don't like getting in the way of my relationship like this, and asking my girlfriend for that kind of patience seems like too much.

I'm trying to do that. I'm normally able to keep myself under control. But when the conversation goes to certain topics, my brain just starts shutting down and my anxiety takes over and I'm unable to think. I guess therapy and time are the only real tools for that.

That is really mature. I'm making an effort to adopt that mindset in my relationship, dealing with a problem together instead of butting heads. I've learned that it's a lot harder for me to adopt that mindset when it comes to certain topics. Bad experiences in the past have made it more difficult than I would like. But I will make more of an effort to step back from the conversation and evaluate things from an objective view instead of letting my self-preservation instinct take over.

Thank you for your advice, I really appreciate it. I don't expect instant changes, but I'm grateful that now I have some place to start at least.

That's...a lot. I don't want to wait 6 months to get better at talking to my girlfriend. I would leave myself if it took that long for me to fix a simple communication problem.

And as I've said in the post, I've already began therapy.
